description: Injects the record's structural open surface (co-citation and stem/title-overlap candidates over .ledger) into a fresh agent's context at session start, and into every Task-dispatched subagent's context at its own start (node/dispatch-anchoring: SessionStart alone never fires for a subagent — a distinct event, SubagentStart, does). Also runs a SHADOW-MODE PreToolUse check on every Agent/Task dispatch (node/cond-hooks): it logs what the composer's dispatch rules would have flagged and never emits a deny — see harness/pretooluse_agent_shadow.py's own docstring for the fail-open contract this relies on.
